newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Seven says MGM 3-mth profit US$16.7mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Seven says MGM 3-mth profit US$16.7mln.

text.p: Television network operator Seven Network Ltd said on Wednesday that its 50 percent-owned Hollywood film studio Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc reported earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) of US$16.7 million in the period from October 10 last year to December 31.
The MGM profit announcement was made by Seven in a statement accompanying the Australian company's half year profit result.
Seven and its partner, United States billionaire Kirk Kerkorian, acquired MGM in September last year.
